description: EXPLICIT release-membership manifest: the exact set of tracked paths that ship in a release archive. Membership is an edit to this file, never a silent consequence of a class rule. It is deliberately NOT 'public-core + all shared/infra': PUBLIC-CORE.md calls tests/ 'not itself the shippable harness', so a blanket class rule would drag non-shippable fixtures into the distribution. It is also not public-core-only: requirements.txt and requirements/ are shared/infra yet are required to install, so a public-core-only archive would be unusable.

include_rationale.requirements.txt: shared/infra, but the harness cannot install without its dependency spec.
include_rationale.requirements/**: shared/infra hash-pinned lockfiles; scripts/bootstrap installs from these, so a release without them cannot bootstrap.
include_rationale.VERSION: shared/infra release marker; consumers and the verifier read it to confirm the archive matches the tag.
include_rationale.PUBLIC-CORE.md: shared/infra governance ledger, but scripts/check-public-core.sh ships (scripts/ is public-core) and READS this ledger; omitting it would ship a checker that cannot run.
include_rationale.release-membership.v1.json: this manifest itself: scripts/verify-release-manifest.sh validates the DOWNLOADED archive's contents against it, so it must travel inside the archive rather than being fetched from a source checkout the verifier is forbidden to rebuild from.
include_rationale.settings.json: public-core: the one hand-maintained settings source in its clean public form (no install path, CLI-owned key or personal entry; machine values live in the untracked overlay settings.machine.json, which never ships). It ships because an installed archive has no other settings source: init renders the working file from it plus the overlay. Formerly excluded as the maintainer's live private-lab config.

exclude_rationale.tests/**: PUBLIC-CORE.md classifies tests/ as the test net that supports the core and is 'not itself the shippable harness'. baseline.yml already runs pytest with --ignore=tests/generated. Excluding it also removes the 21 tests/generated fixture files that carry the maintainer workspace path — the ledger-consistent resolution, rather than a per-file exemption.
exclude_rationale..github/**: build/CI meta; not part of the installed harness.
exclude_rationale..claude/**: repo-identity sentinel and per-repo session state; not shipped.
exclude_rationale..gitattributes: shared/infra repo meta: declares the claude-settings clean/smudge filter for settings.json, which init registers inside a git checkout; an extracted archive is not one.
exclude_rationale.pytest.ini: test-runner config; belongs with the excluded test net.
exclude_rationale.conftest.py: pytest collection config; belongs with the excluded test net.
